Component methods

Element documents methods as well as props – clearSelection(), setCheckedKeys(), validate(). These are functions on the component, so update_el_*() cannot reach them.

el_call()
Call a method of an Element component

Loading from the server

Where Element takes a JavaScript function to fetch data – a lazy tree, cascader or tree table – the component asks the server instead, and this answers.

el_load_children()
Answer a component that asked the server for data

Escape hatches

For anything the wrappers do not cover: build your own component the way this package builds its own, write raw Element tags, or update a Vue instance directly.

el_widget()
Assemble a component: host, Vue instance, Shiny input binding
JS()
Mark a string as JavaScript
el
Element UI tags, for markup inside a component
template()
Generate a <template> tag for Vue/Element UI slot usage
update_vue_data()
Set fields of a component's Vue instance
